task: Find out what to do when I lose an item on a bus on us.megabus.
agent_final_answer: If you lose an item on a Megabus bus, you must report a lost item inquiry to their lost and found department by filling out a form (linked from the Help/FAQ answer "What do I do if I lost an item on the bus?"). Once you submit the necessary information about the lost item, it is entered into their system for processing by the lost and found department. The lost and found department responds to all loss inquiries; the response may take several days because an investigation to find the item must be completed. Megabus makes every attempt to return lost items to their rightful owners and will assist with retrieval to the best of its ability.
